notes: Overlay: now uses Dauntless Forever's own Boss Health Bar by default (Settings > Behemoth overlay > Style). It is built into DF's loader and reads the game directly, so there is no lag in co-op; the game mod does no searches at all then. Lantern's own card (element, stagger, BROKEN parts) is still there as a choice, but can make the game stutter in co-op. If you had the overlay on, DF's bar is switched back on for you. Start the game again for the change to apply.
